class.name: SceneTree
class.brief_description: Manages the root node, current scene, and scene updates.
class.description: Scene changes and queued node deletion are applied when the engine processes pending changes.

method.name: GetRoot
method.description: Gets the root viewport node owned by this scene tree.
method.returns: The root node. The current scene is a child below a scene viewport, not the root itself.

method.name: GetScene
method.description: Gets the root node of the current scene.
method.returns: The current scene root, or null if no current scene is in this tree.

method.name: ClearScene
method.description: Queues the current scene and its child nodes for deletion. Does nothing if there is no current scene. Deletion happens when the engine processes pending changes.

method.name: ChangeScene
method.description: Queues a new current scene and queues the old scene for deletion. The change takes effect when the engine processes pending changes.
method.param: The new scene root, normally created by PackedScene.Instantiate. Pass null to clear the current scene.

method.name: GetWorldCamera
method.description: Gets the current camera of the scene viewport.
method.returns: The current 3D camera, or null if no camera is set.

method.name: GetRaycastSpace
method.description: Gets the raycast space owned by this scene tree.
method.returns: The raycast space. Its ray query methods are not exposed to C# yet.

method.name: GetDeltaSeconds
method.description: Gets the time step from the most recent scene update.
method.returns: The update time in seconds. This is the same time step passed to Node.OnProcess.
